Date: October 19, 2026
To, Listing Department,
BSE Limited, Floor 25,
P. J. Towers, Dalal Street,
Mumbai – 400 001
Scrip Code: 530745
Subject: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Receipt of Listing Approval for 49,50,495 Equity Shares.
Dear Sir / Madam,
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)
Regulations, 2015,
We wish to inform the Exchange that the Company has received Listing Approval from BSE
Limited vide letter Ref No. LOD/PREF/SS/FIP/978/2026-27 dated October 19, 2026. The
approval is for the listing of 49,50,495 Equity Shares of face value Rs. 10/- each issued at a
premium of Rs. 30.40/- per share on a preferential basis to Non-Promoters pursuant to the
conversion of Loans.
A copy of the Listing Approval letter received from BSE Limited is enclosed herewith for
your records.
Kindly take the above information on record.
Thanking you,
Yours faithfully,
For ACS Technologies Limited.

SHILPI
GUNJAN

Digitally signed by SHILPI
GUNJAN
Date: 2026.10.19 19:19:07
+05'30'

Shilpi Gunjan
Compliance Officer and Company Secretary
